title: Folding Commutes with an Action
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type with decidable equality, let $S$ be a type, let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a word over $\Gamma$, let $c$ be a configuration with $k$ work tapes and state set $S$ on input $x$, and let $a$ be an action over $\Gamma$ with state set $S$. Applying to the folded configuration of $c$ the translated action formed from each work head's current side and the folded symbol under that head yields exactly the folded configuration obtained by applying $a$ to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: x is a list over Γ
c is a configuration with k work tapes and state set S on x
a is an action with k work tapes over Γ and state set S
replaced:
Let $\Gamma$ be an alphabet with decidable equality, $a$ an action of a
$k$-work-tape machine over $\Gamma$ with state set $S$, and $c$ a configuration of
such a machine on an input $x$.  Applying to the folded configuration of $c$ the
translated action --- formed from each work head's current side and the physical
cells under the folded heads --- yields the folded configuration of the result of
applying $a$ to $c$.
